mchod pa brnyes/ /de ltas gang zhig rgyal ba'i yon tan 'dzin 'tshal des/ /shes rab pha rol phyin blang 'di ni thar pa lags/ /sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste/ /tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /dge chos chud mi gzan phyir yongs su 'dzin pa yin/ /'di ni chos rnams thams cad tshul gcig ston par byed/ /dper na 'dzam bu'i 7gling na shing rnams bye ba stong / /rnam pa sna tshogs rnam pa du ma gzugs mang ba/ /grib mar gyur pa'i grangs su brjod pa ma gtogs par/ /grib ma sna tshogs med cing bye brag yod ma yin/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i pha rol phyin lnga 'di dag kyang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i ming nyid thob par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid phyir yongs su bsngos ②byas na/ /byang chub ces byar drug po 'di kun ro gcig 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' gal te rab tu mi shes bzhin/ /gzugs dang 'du shes tshor dang sems pa rnam par shes/ /mi rtag yongs su ston pa bcos la spyod pa ste/ /mkhas pa nam yang chos rnams 'jig par mi byed do / /gang la gzugs min tshor min 'du shes mi dmigs shing / /rnam par shes pa ma yin sems pa shimi dmigs la/ /chos kun skye med stong pa'i tshul du rab shes pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /la las gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /ci phyir zhe na smra mchog de dag 'dir bslabs nas/ /chos rnams mtha' dag stong pa nyid du 'dir ston byed/ /de thos nyan thos myur du rnam par grol la reg /rang 31—406

rgyal byang chub dang ni sangs rgyas byang chub reg /myu gu med par 'jig rten sdong ①'byung yong med na/ /de la yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu ga la 'byung / /byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yong med na/ /'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gang tshe 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed / /de tshe sems can las byed brtson pa de bzhin du/ /mkhas pa shes phyir 'jig rten byang chub sems byung na/ /ye shes kyis ni sems can yon tan chos dang ldan/ /dper na ma dros mtsho la klu bdag med gyur na/ / 'dzam bu'i (0gling 'dir chu klung 'bab par ga la 'gyur/ /chu klung med na me tog 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho la yang rin chen gzugs mang med par 'gyur / /de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs kyi/ /ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun tu ga la 'byung / /ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med / /rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur / /'jig rten 'di na snang byed srog chags ji snyed pa/ca /kun gyis snang bar bya phyir 'od rnams phyung (sku)ba bas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gcig phyung ches mchog ste/ /snang byed tshogs kyi 'od rnams kun gyis char mi phod / /nyan thos tshogs rnams ji snyed sbyin dang tshul khrims dang / /bsgom 'a)dang rab tu ldan pa'i bsod nams tshogs skyed 96pa'ang / /byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi (3)rang sems gcig la/ /nyan thos tshogs kyi bsod nams phung pos char mi phod/ /'das dus sngon (85gyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang / /zhing mang mtha' yas bye stong dag na gang bzhugs dang / /gang yang mya ngan 'das pa 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir rin chen 31—407

chos ston pa/ /dang po nya)byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed bskyed pa nas/ /rnam par 'dren pa rnams kyi dam chos zad kyi dus/ /de 90bar rgyal ba de dag bsod nams gang yin pa/ /pha rol phyin dang ldan dang sangs rgyas chos gang dang / /gang yang sangs rgyas sras rnams dang ni nyan thos dang / /slob dang mi slob dge ba zag bcas (5༄zag med pa/ /bsdus nas byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi 4)rang zhing / /'gro ba'i don rgyu byang chub phyir ni thams cad bsngo/ /yongs bsngo tshoganagal te sems su 'du shes 'byung 'gyur zhing / /byang chub 'du shes yongs bsngo sems can 'du shes na/ /'du shes phyir na lta gnas sems ni gsum la chags/ /dmigs pa yod pas yongs su bsngo bar chud ma yin/ /gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing zad pa dang / /gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang / /chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na/ /de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su bsngos pa yin/ /gal te mtshan mar byed na de ni bsngo ma yin/ /ji ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin/ /ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba/ /dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ /de ltas 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ba bslab bya ste/ /ji ltar rgyal ba de dag dge ba de mkhyen pa'i/ /rnam pa gang yin 'byung gang mtshan nyid gang yin la/ /rjes su yid (6)rang de lta de ltar yongs su bsngo/ /de ltar bsod nams byang chub yongs su sngo (7byed na/ /dug med sangs rgyas mi spong rgyal bas gsungs pa smra/ /de ltar yongs bsngo dpa' bos 'jig rten dmigs can gyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed thams cad zil gyis gnon //dmus long dmigs 9)bu med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams/ /lam yang mi shes grong 31—408

khyer 'jug par ga la 'gyur/ /shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'di/ /dmigs ①bu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur na/ /de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing (ge'adi yi ming thob bo/ /dper na ri mo'i las ni yongs zin mig med pa/ /ji srid (mimig ma bris pas rngan pa mi thob bzhin/ /gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag chos//shes rab rnam par bshig nas rdul tsam mi dmigs tshe/ /'jig rten dag na shes rab pha rol phyin grangs 'gro/ /nam mkha' gang la'ang cung zad mi gnas de dang 'dra/ /gal te bdag ni rgyal ba'i shes rab spyad bya zhing / /sems can sdug bsngal reg pa khrag khrig mang dgrol sems/ /sems can 'du shes yongs rtog ④byang chub sems dpa' de(5)/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod ma (7yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig sngon chad spyod pa'i tshe/ /pha rol phyin 'dir spyod pa mkhas pa som nyi med/ /thos ma thag tu des ni ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ /des ni byang chub zhi ba myur du rtogs par 'gyur/ /sngon spyod tshe na sangs rgyas khrag khrig bkur byas kyang / /rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin la ma dad na/ /thos nas blo chung de yis 'di ni spong byed de/ /spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro/ /de lta bas na gal te sangs rgyas ye shes mchog /reg par 'dod na rgyal ba'i yum 'dir dad par gyis / /dper na tshong pa rin chen gling du song nas ni/ /zong zad slar log lta bur gyur na mi rung ngo / /gzugs kyi dag pa 'bras bu dag par rig par bya//'bras bu gzugs dag thams cad mkhyen nyid dag par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid 'bras bu dag dang gzugs dag pa/ /nam mkha'i khams dang 31—409

mtshungs te dbyer med gcad du med/ /dpa' bo gar spyod shes rab pha rol phyin pa yis/ /khams gsum yang dag 'das la rnam par grol ba'ang min/ /nyon mongs bsal bar gyur kyang skye ba ston par byed/ /rga 1)dang na dang 'chi 9nab med kyang 'chi /'pho ston/ /'gro ba 'di dag ming dang gzugs kyi 'dam la chags / /rlung gi 'khor lo lta bu'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyamatshon / /'gro ba 'khrul pa ri dgas rgyar chud 'drar 5)shes nas/ /shes rab ldan pa mkha' la bya bzhin rnam par rgyu/ /spyod pa yongs dag gang zhig gzugs la mi spyod cing / /rnam shes 'du shes tshor ba sems par mi spyod na/ /de ltar spyod pa chags pa thams cad yongs spong zhing / /chags las rnam grol bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyod/ /de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ /chags pa bcad nenas 'gro la chags pa med par 'gro/ /nyi ma sgra gcan gza' bral lhang nger 7sku'adug pa dang / /me btang rtswa (8)dang shing dang nags tshal bsregs 95pa bzhin/ /chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin dag cing yongs dag par / /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin lta nyu )na/ /byed pa po yang mi dmigs chos kun mi dmigs te/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /rgyal ba la ni lha rgyal brgya byin gyis zhus pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab spyod pa ji ltar brtson/ /phung po khams la rdul tsam brtson par hunyemi byed cing / /phung por mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpa'i brtson/ /gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sgyu ma 'drar thos nas/ /som nyi med cing slob la phyir zhing spyod byed pa/ /sems can de ni ring nas theg chen zhugs rig bya/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang la lhag byas yin/ /dgon pa'i lam ni dpag 31—410

tshad mang por zhugs pa'i mis/ /gnag rdzi mtshams kyi nags tshal phun sum tshogs mthong nas/ /'di dag nya)grong dang grong khyer nye ba'i rtags (5)snyam ste/ /dbugs phyin rnyed par 'gyur zhing chom rkun 5)'jigs pa med/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs su tshol latshe rgyal rnams kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di mnyan pa gang thob pa/ /de ni dbugs phyin thob par gyur cing 'jigs med de/ /dgra bcom sa la ma yin rkyen rtogs sa la min/ /mi zhig rgya mcho1re chu ni blta phyir 'gro ba yis/ /gal te 2shing dang nags tshal ri mthong da dung ring / /ci ste rtags ma mthong na rgya mtsho chen po ni/ /nye bar gyur to snyam ste de la som nyi med//de ltar (3byang chub dam par rab zhugs rgyal ba yin)/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di mnyan par (8)rig par bya/ /rnam par 'dren pas mngon sum lung bstan ma gyur (7kyang / /sangs rgyas byang chub ring por mi thogs bdag reg 'gyur/ /dpyid dus bzang la sdong po lo ma lhags gyur na/ /yal gas ring por mi hu )thogs lo 'bras me tog bskrunam/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di su yi tu lag thob pal/ /ring por mi thogs 'dren pa rnams kyi byang chub thob/ /dper na bud med sbrum gang sdug bsngal nyen gyur na/ /de ni de yi btsa' ba'i dus la bab ces bya/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i shes rab nyan/ /dga' dang 'dun pa skyed pa myur du byang chub reg3ge/ shes rab pha birol phyin mchog spyod tshe rnal 'byor pa/ /gzugs kyi 'phel ba dang ni yongs su 'grib mi mthong //gang zhig chos dang chos min chos dbyings mi mthong zhing / /mya ngan 'das la mi reg de ni shes rab gnas/ /gang zhig 'dir spyod sangs rgyas chos rnams mi rtog ste/ /stobs dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa byang chub zhi mi rtog /rnam par mi 31—411

rtog rtog bral byin gyi rlabs kyis spyod/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /smra ba'i zla ba sangs rgyas la ni rab 'byor zhus/ /yon tan dga' ba rnams kyi bar du gcod gang lags/ /ston pas bka' stsal bar du gcod par 'gyur mang 1ste/ /de las re shig (bcung zad tsam zhig yongs su brjod / /rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig 'dri (kyetshe/ /spobs pa tha dad rnam pa du ma 'byung 'gyur zhing / /'gro ba'i don ma byas par glog bzhin myur du yang / /yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba 'di ni bdud kyi las/ /'di bshad tshe na kha cig som nyi za 'gyur te/ /'dren pas 'dir ni bdag gi ming yang yongs ma brjod/ /rigs dang sa dang rus kyang yongs su ma brjod ces/ /'di ni nyan 4)par mi 'gyur spong 'gyur bdud kyi las/ /de ltar mi shes de dag rtsa ba bor nas ni/ /rmongs pas yal ga dag dang 'dab ma tshol ⑤bar 'gyurasti/ /glang po rnyed nas glang po'i rjes ni tshol (leb ltar/ /shes rab pha rol phyin thos mdo tshol 8༄de bzhin no/ /dper na la las ro brgya (7ldan pa'i zas rnyed la/ /zas mchog rnyed nas zas ngan tshol 1 )bar byed pa 31ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' pha rol phyin pa 'di rnyed nas/ /dgra bcom sa yi 7byang chub tshol 8byed de bzhin no/ /bsti 7ltang 'dod par 'gyur zhing rnyed pa 'dod 'gyur dang / /lta (8dang bcas pa'i sems kyis khyim 'dris byed ldan zhing / /chos btang nas ni chos min bya ba spyod 'gyur ba/ /lam bor lam gol 'gro ba 'di ni bdud kyi las / /gang dag 7de yi tshe na 'dun cing dad gyur nas/ /chos kyi dam pa 'di ni nyan du song ba las/ /de dag gis ni chos smra bya ba ldan rig nas/ /dga' ba med cing yid mi bde bar gyur nas 'gro/ /de yi tshe na bdud kyi las 31—412

'di 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de tshe gang dag gis ni dge slong mang dkrugs nas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di 'dzin par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bar du gcod pa rnam mang gzhan yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rin chen rin thang med pa rnyed 'gyur gang dag yin/ /de dag dkon la dus rnams rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang de bzhin rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog /rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang / /theg pa gsar du zhugs pa'i sems can blo chung ba/ /gang zhig dkon pa'i rin chen 'di ni ma rnyed 1)pa/ /de la bar chad bya phyir bdud ni spro bar 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag yongs su 'dzin la sbyor / /ma zhig na bar gyur la bu ni mang yod pa/ /de kun yid mi bde zhing de la rim gro byed/ /de bzhin phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi sangs rgyas kyang / /yum gyur shes rab dam pa 'di la dgongs pa mdzad/ /gang dag 'das dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon 9migang dang / /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung 'gyur de dag 'di las 'byung (yi/ /'jig rten ston pa rgyal ba rnams kyi skyed ⑤byed yum/ /sems can gzhan gyi sems kyi spyod pa ston par byed/ /'jig rten de bzhin nyid dang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ /rang rgyal de bzhin nyid dang rgyal sras de bzhin nyid/ /gcig pa nyid de dngos bral gzhan min de bzhin nyid/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen/ /mkhas pa ⑤'jig rten gnas sam mya ngan 'das kyang rung / /chos nyid skyon med chos rnams stong pa 'di gnas te/ /byang chub sems dpas de bzhin nyid 'di rjes su rtogs/ /de phyir de bzhin gshegs zhes sangs rgyas mtshan gsol to//shes rab pha rol phyin pa dga' tshal la rten 76)pa/ /stobs bcu rnam 'dren 31—413

rnams kyi spyod yul 'di yin te/ /sems can sdug bsngal ngan song gsum las yongs 'don kyang / /de dag nam yang sems can 'du shes 'gyur ba med/ /dper na seng ge ri sul brten nas 'jigs med par/ /ri dgas (1)phra mo mang skrag byed cing sgra sgrogs 2)ltar/ /mi yi seng ge shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas//mu stegs can mang skrag byed 'jig rten sgra yang sgrogs(kye/ /dper na nam mkhar gnas pa'i nyi ma'i 4kyi'od zer ni/ /sa 'di skems par byed cing gzugs kyang rab tu ston/ /de bzhin chos rgyal shes rab pha rol phyin brten (gepa / /sred pa'i chu klung skems (6)shing chos kyang rab tu ston/ /gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing / /'du shes mthong ba med la sems pa 7)mi mthong zhing / /gang la rnam par shes dang sems yid mthong med pa/ /'di ni chos mthong yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa/ /nam mkha' ji ltar mthong ste don 'di brtag par gyis/ /de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin/ /gang (8)gis de ltar mthong ba de yis chos kun mthong / /rgyal po btang snyoms 'dug rkicing blon po kun byed ltar/ /sangs rgyas mdzad dang nyan thos chos rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad shes rab pha rol phyin pa byed/ /rgyal po grong du mi 'gro yul 'khor mi 'gro la/ /rang gi yul nas 'du ba thams cad sdud 7pa ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' sna1chos nyid gang du'ang mi 'gro la/ /sangs rgyas sa yi tsoyon tan gang yin thams cad sdud1nyi/ /gang la bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' dad brtan yod/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog la bsam sbyor ba/ /nyan 31—414

thos rang rgyal sa gnyis (1)shin tu 'das byas nas/ /zil gyis mi non rin)rgyal ba'i byang chub myur du thobacigu/ /dper na rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru ni chag gyur la//mi gang ro'am rtswa'am ci)shing ni mi 'dzin pa/ /chu dbus 'jig par 'gyur te ngogs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin par 'gyur//de ltar dad ldan dad pa (5thob pa gang zhig ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin yum rjes su mi 'jug min/ /de dag thabs kyi yon tan shes rab yongs zin na/ /mchog tu rmad byung bde gshegs byang chub myur du reg /dper na la las rdza so ma btang chu skyed na/ /nyam 96)chung phyir ni myur du 'jig par rig par bya/ /so btang bum par chu skyed lam du 'jig pa yi/ /'jigs 3)pa med cing bde bar khyim du phyin par 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' dad pa mang 58)gyur kyang / /shes rab rnam par nyams na myur du ma rung 'gyur/ /dad pas shes rab kyis ni yongs su zin gyur na/ /sa gnyis shin tu 'das te byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ /dper na bcos legs ma byas gru ni rgya mtsho'i nang / /nor dang bcas shing tshong par bcas te 'jig 95par 'gyur/ /gru de legs par bcos legs byas dang ldan gyur na/ /mi 'jig nor dang bcas par ngogs su phyin par gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dad pas yongs bsgos lca )kyang / /shes rab med na byang chub las ni myur nyams 'gyur/ /de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog ldan na/ /ma smas 1lham nyams rgyal ba'i byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /lo brgya nyi shu lon te rgas shing sdug bsngal mi/ /langs kyang bdag nyid 'gro bar nus pa ma yin te/ /de ni g.yas g.yon gnyis nas nyunyemi yis brten nyu byas na/ /'gyel ba'i 'jigs pa med cing bde blag 'gro 31—415

bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' (1)shes rab stobs chung ba/ /rab tu zhugs par gyur kyang bar dun)du nyams par 'gyur/ /de nyid thabs mkhas shes rab mchog gis yongs zin na/ /mi nyams de bzhin gshegs kyi byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang po'i las kyi sar gnas gang / /lhag pa'i bsam pas sangs rgyas byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ /slob ma bzang po bla ma gus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bstan dpar bya/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /de dag shes rab pha rol phyin pa rjes su ston/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten 4to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsung / /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang de bzhin brtson 'grus (5)dang / /bsam gtan shes rab byang chub yongs su bsngo bar gyis/ /byang chub phung por zhen nas mchog 'dzin ma byed cig(6) /dang po'i (7)las can de la de skad bstan par bya/ /de ltar spyod pa legs 'tsho smra ba'i zla ba rnams/ /'gro ba'i skyabs dang nadapung gnyen dang ni gnas yin te/ /rten dang blo dang gling dang yongs 'dren don 'dod 9pa/ /gsal byed sgron ma chos mchog smra ba mi 'khrugs yin/ /grags chen ldan rnams bya dka' go cha gyon byed de/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams kyi go cha min/ /theg gsum 'du shes bral zhing yongs su bzung ba med / /mi ldog g.yo ba med cing mi 'khrugs chos can yin/ /de dag 'di 'dra'i chos dang ldan zhing spros pa med/ /the tshom som nyi yid gnyis bral zhing don dang ldan/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa thos nas mi nur ba/ /gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog cing mi ldog rig par bya/ /'dren pa rnams kyi chos 'di zab ste 31—416

mthong bar dka'/ /sus kyang rtogs pa med cing thob par 'gyur med pa/ /de phyir phan mdzad brtser ldan byang chub brnyes nas ni/ /sems can tshogs su 0)shes snyam thugs khral chung bar mdzad/ /sems can rnams ni gnas la dga' zhing yul rnams 'dod/ /'dzin la gnas shing mi mkhas blun rmongs mun pa bzhin / /thob par bya ba'i chos ni gnas med 'dzin med de/ /des na 'jig rten dag dang rtsod pa 'byung ba yin/ /nam mkha'i khams ni shar gyi phyogs dang lho phyogs dang / /de bzhin nub kyi phyogs dang byang phyogs pha mtha' yasal/ /steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu'i ji snyed rnams na'ang yod/ /tha dad gyur pa med cing bye brag gyur pa med/ /'das pa'i de bzhin nyid gang ma byon de bzhin nyid/ /da ltar de bzhin nyid gang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ /chos kun de bzhin nyid gang rgyal ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /chos kyi de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad bye brag med/ /bde gshegs byang chub tha dad chos dang bral gyur pa/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig thob 'dod pa/ /thabs dang ldan pas shes rab pha rol phyin la sbyor/ /'dren pa'i shes rab med na thob par 'gyur ma yin/ /bya zhig lus che dpag tshad brgya rtsa lnga bcu par/ /gyur la 'dab gshog zad de nyam rtsal yod min na/ /de yis sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas 'dzam gling 'dir/ /bdag nyid mchongs na der ni nyam 5)nyes gyur pa yin//rgyal ba rnams kyi (kyepha rol phyin pa lnga 'di yang / /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang por bsgrubs 90byas shing / /smon lam mtha' yas rgya chen 'jig rten rtag bsten kyang / /thabs med shes rab bral ba nyan thos nyid du ltung 95)/ /sangs rgyas theg pa 'di la nges par 'byung 'dod gang / /'gro ba kun la sems snyoms 31—417

pha ma'i 'du shes dang / /phan pa'i sems dang byams pa'i yid kyis brtul bya zhing / /tha ba med cing drang la tshig 'jam smra bar bya/ /'jig rten mgon la gnas brtan rab 'byor yongs zhus pa/ /yon tan rgya mtsho stiston mongs ma mchis rtags bstan gsol/ /mthu che ba dag ji ltar slar ldog mi 'gyur ba/ /de ltar yon tan phyogs tsam rgyal bas lung bstan gsol/ /tha dad 'du shes bral zhing rigs pa ldan tshig smra/ /dge sbyong dag dang bram ze gzhan la rten ②mi byed / /mkhas pas dus rnams rtag tu ngan song gsum po spangs/ /de dag dge bcu'i las kyi lam la mngon (kyepar brtson/ /zang zing med par 'gro la chos ni rjes su ston/ /chos la gcig tu dga' zhing rtag tu tshig 'jam ldan/ /'gro 'chag 4 nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan/ /gnya' shing gang tsam blta (de zhing 'gro la sems 'khrul med/ /gtsang byas gtsang ma'i gos 'chang gsum po dben zhing (6༄dag /rnyed 'dod ma yin khyu mchog rtag tu chos 'dod pa//bdud kyi yul las 'das shing gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog /bsam gtan bzhi la bsam gtan bsam gtan der mi gnas/ /grags pa 'dod pa ma yin khro bas sems dkris 75med/ /khyim par gyur kyang rtag tu dngos po kun ma chags/ /'tsho ba'i phyir ni ya ngas rdzu ri longs spyod tshol rdzimi byed/ /drag shul spyod sngags mi byed bud med 7sbyor sngags min/ /'dod pa'i las can pho 7mor 'gyur zhes ston mi byed/ /rab tu dben pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson/ /'thab dang rtsod dang bral zhing byams pa'i sems kyang brtan/ /kun mkhyen 'dod cing brtan 12la rtag tu gzhol sems ldan/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo'i skye bo'i yul mtha' rnam 1 par spangs/ /rang gi sa la dogs med rtag tu ri rab 31—418

'dral/ /chos phyir srog kyang 'dor zhing rnal 'byor rab tu brtson/ /mi ldog rtags ni 'di dag yin par shes par bya/ /gzugs dang tshor dang 'du shes sems pa rnam shes rnams/ /zab ste rang bzhin mtshan ma med cing rab zhi ba/ /dper na mda' yis rgya mtsho'i gting thug tshol 1)ba ltar/ /shes rab kyis ni brtags na phung po'i gting mi rnyed/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de ltar zab gyur cing / /theg pa don dam chags med gang la phung po dang / /khams dang skye mched yod min chos 'di rtogs pa de'i/ /bsod nams yang dag grub pa de las ci zhig yod/ /dper na 'dod chags chos la spyod pa'i skyes bu zhig /bud med dus btab de dang ma phrad de yi 9 ni/ /nyin gcig 95)sems kyi rnam rtog ④spyod pa ji snyed pa/ /de snyed bskal par 9gebyang chub sems dpas (6)thob par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig bskal mang bye stong du/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal sbyin ⑦byed tshul khrims srung byed kyang / /gang zhig shes rab pha rol phyin mchog ldan pa'i chos/ /brjod pa'i legs la sbyin dang tshul khrims char mi phod/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig shes rab mchog bsgoms te/ /de las langs nas gos pa med pa'i chos brjod cing / /de yang 'gro ba'i don phyir byang chub rgyur bsngo na/ /dge ba de dang mnyam pa 'jig rten gsum na med//bsod nams de yang gsog dang de bzhin stong pa dang / /gsob dang ya ma brla tshonadang snying po med par shes/ /de ltar bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyad spyod na / /spyod tshe bsod nams dpag tu med pa yongs su 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kyis bshad rab tu sbyar cing (9༄rab bstan pa'i/ /chos 'di thams cad brjod pa tsam du zad shes nas/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang por brjod byas kyang //31—419

chos kyi dbyings la zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi pha rol phyin ces bya ba gang / /chos de rnams kyang ming tsam du ni yongs su bsgrags/ /yongs bsngo rlom sems med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /nyams pa med cing sangs rgyas byang chub mchog reg 'gyur/ /'bru mar snying po 'bar ba phrad pa dang po yis/ /snying po tshig min de med par yang de mi tshig /me lce phrad pa tha mas snying po tshig min la/ /me lce tha ma med par 0)snying po tshig min ltar/ /dang po'i sems kyis byang chub mchog reg ma yin la/ /de med par yang de la reg par nus ma yin/ /tha ma'i sems kyis byang chub zhi ba thob min la/ /de med par yang de thob nus pa ma yin no/ /sa bon las ni myu gu me tog 'bras bu 'byung / /de yang 'gags la shing yang med pa der min ltar/ /de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub rgyu yin te/ /de yang 'gags la byang chub med pa de ma yin/ /rin chu yi na thigs pas bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar/ /rim gyis nyung ngu nyung 4)bus de yongs 'gengs pa ltar/ /de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub mchog 5rgyu ste6/ /rim gyis dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /stong pa mtshan med smon pa med pa'i chos spyod cing / /mya ngan 'das la mi reg mtshan mar mi spyod pa/ /dper na mnyan pa mkhas pa phar 'gro tshur 7'gro yang 98)/ /mtha' gnyis mi gnas rgya mtshor gnas pa med pa bzhin/ /de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam bdag /stobs bcus lung bstan byang chub reg 'gyur rlom 9 sems med/ /'di la ci yang med ces byang chub skrag pa med/ /de ltar spyod pa bde gshegs shes rab spyod pa yin/ /'jig rten dgon pa'i lam dang mu ge nad bcas par/ /mthong nas skrag pa 31—420

med cing de nas go gyon te/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar rtag tu brtson zhing rab shes nas//yongs su skyo ba'i yid ni rngul tsam skyed 6)mi byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i shes rab spyod byed cing (mi/ /phung po 'di dag gdod nas stong zhing skye med shes / /mnyam par ma bzhag sems can khams la snying rje 'jug /bar skabs der yang sangs rgyas chos las yongs mi nyams/ /dper na skyes bu mkhas pa yon tan kun ldan zhing / /stobs ldan mi thub brtson byas sgyu rtsal cho ga shes/ /'phong dang bzo gnas mang po'i pha rol phyin gyur cing / /sgyu ma sgrub shes 'gro don rab tu 'dod pa zhig /pha dang ma dang chung mar bcas par yongs bsdus nas/ /dgra byed mang ba dgon pa'i lam du phyin pa dang / de yis dpa' zhing rtul ①sod skyes bu mang sprul te/ /bde bar song zhing phyir yang khyim du 'ong ba ltar/ /de bzhin de tshe byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa yang /sems can khams rnams kun tu snying rje cher bskyed cing / /bdud bzhi dag dang sa gnyis las kyang rab 'das nas/ /ting 'dzin mchog la gnas shing byang chub reg mi byed/ /mkha' la rlung brten ④de la chu yi ⑤phung po brten⑥/ /de la sa chachen 'di brten (8)de la 'gro ba rtso)brten / /sems can las la spyod pa'i rgyu ni de 'dra ste/ /nam mkha' gang la gnas yin don 'di bsam par gyis//de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid gnas pa/ /'gro la sems can shes pa'i smon lam rten can gyis/ /bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs du ma ston byed cing //mya ngan 'das la mi reg stong par gnas pa med/ /gang gi tshe na byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ /stong pa zhi ba'i ting 'dzin dam pa 'di spyod pa//bar skabs der ni mtshan ma rab tu sgom mi byed/ /mtshan ma med par gnas 31—421

shing zhi la rab zhi spyod/ /bar snang 'phur ba'i bya la gnas yod ma yin te/de na gnas pa ma yin sa la lhung mi 'gyur/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnam thar sgor spyod pa/ /mya ngan 'das la mi reg mtshan mar spyod ma yin/ /dper na 'phong bslabs skyes bus gnam du mda' 'phangs te/ /mda' gzhan dag gis phyi bzhin brgyud ①mar long ②btags te/ /snga ma'i mda' de sa la ltung ba'i skabs mi 'byed/ /mi de 'dod na mda' de sa la ltung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog spyod pa/ /shes rab thabs stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis ni rnam spyod pa/ /de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba ji srid ma rdzogs pa/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni thob mi byed/ /dper na dge slong rdzu 'phrul stobs mchog ldan pa zhig /nam mkhar gnas te cig char ②cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul//'gro dang 'chag pa dang ni nyal dang 'dug pa ston/ /de ni skyo ba med cing de la dub pa med/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa stong gnas shing / /ye shes rdzu 'phrul pha rol son la gnas pa med/ /'gro ba dag la bya ba rnam pa mtha' yas ston/ /bskal pa bye bar skyo ba med cing dub pa med/ /dper na mi 'ga' g.yang sa chen por 'dug byed cing / /lag pa gnyi gas ④gdugs gnyis 'dzin cing nam mkha' la(pe/ /mchong ⑥bar byed cing g.yang sa chen por lus bor nas/ /ltung bar mi 'gyur ji srid der ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa snying rjer gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi gdugs ni yongs bzung ste/ /chos rnams stong pa mtshan med smon pa med rtog cing / /mya ngan 'das la reg pa med la chos kyang mthong / /dper na rin chen 'dod pa rin chen gling song ste/ /rin chen rnyed nas phyir yang khyim 31—422

du 'ong 'gyur ba/ /der ni ded dpon 'ba' 0)zhig bde bar 'tsho byed cing / /gnyen bshes tshogs yid mi bder 'jog pa min pa ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' stong nyid rin chen gyi/ /gling du song ste bsam gtan dbang po stobs thob pa/ /mya ngan 'das la reg pa 'ba' zhig (kyemangon dga' zhing / /sems can sdug bsngal yid du 'jog par (mi'agyur ma yin/ /dper na don gnyer tshong pa rgyus shes bya ba'i phyir/ /bar gyi grong khyer grong rdal ④grong gang yin par 'gro/ /der yang mi gnas rin chen gling du'ang mi gnas la/ /rig pa khyim du mi gnas lam la mkhas par 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' gsal te nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal rnams kyi shes pa rnam grol kun la mkhas / /de la mi gnas sangs rgyas ye shes gnas ma yin/ /'dus ma byas la mi gnas lam gyi tshul shes yin/ /gang tshe 'gro la byams pas rjes su 'brel byas nas/ /ting 'dzin stong pa mtshan med smon pa med spyod pa/ /de ni mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur zhe'am/ /'dus byas yin par gdags nus de ni gnas med do/ /dper na sprul pa'i mi lus mi snang ma yin zhing / /de ni ming gis kyang ni gdags par nus pa ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' rnam thar sgor spyod pa/ /de ni ming gis kyang ni gdags par nus ma ⑤yin/ /gal te spyod pa dang ni dbang po yongs dris la/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong pa mtshan ma med pa'i chos/ /yongs su mi ston phyir mi ldog pa sa yi chos mi 'chad de ni lung ma bstan par rig par bya/ /dgra bcom sa dang rkyen gyi sangs rgyas ye shes dang / /khams gsum dag la rmi 76lam na yang mi 'dod cing / /sangs rgyas rnams mthong 'gro la chos kyang ston byed pa/ /de ni mi ldog lung 31—423

bstan yin par rig par bya/ /rmi lam na ni sems can ngan song gsum gnas ①mthong / /skad cig de la ngan song rgyun gcod ⑤smon lam 'debs/ /bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis me yi phung po zhi/ /de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ /mi yi 'jig rten 'byung po'i gdon dang nad mang ba/ /phan dang snying brtser ldan pa'i bden pa'i ②byin gyis zhi/ /'on kyang rlom sems med cing nga rgyal skye med pa/ /de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ /ci ste de ni bden pa'i byin rlabs sna tshogs dag /'byor pas bdag lung bstan snyam rlom sems 'byung ba'am/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyis lung bstan durlom/ /rlom sems gnas pa de ni blo chung shes par bya /ming gi gzhi ⑤las bdud ni nye bar 'ongs gyur nas/ /'di skad smras te 'di ni khyod dang pha ma dang / /khyod kyi bdun mes rgyud kyi bar gyi ming yin zhing / /gang tshe khyod ni sangs rgyas 'gyur ba'i ming 'di yin/ /sbyangs sdom rnal 'byor ldan pa ci 'dra 'byung 'gyur la/ /khyod sngon yon tan tshul yang 'di 'dra'o zhes brjod do/ /de skad gang thos rlom sems byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /bdud kyis yongs su bslang zhing blo chung rig par bya/ /rab tu dben ⑥pa'i grong dang grong khyer ri sul dang / /dgon pa dben pa nags khrod rab tu sten ⑦byed cing //bdag stod ⑧gzhan la smod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /bdud kyis yongs su bslang zhing blo chung rig par bya/ /rtag tu grong dang yul 'khor grong rdal gnas byed cing / /sems can smin byed byang chub brtson pa ma gtogs par/ /de ni dgra bcom rang rgyal 'dod pa gzhan mi skye/ /'di ni bde bar gshegs kyi sras kyis khyadaben par gsungs/ /gang zhig dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa'i ri yi 31—424

sul / /sbrul gyis gang bar lo mang bye bar gnas byed kyang / /dben pa 'di mi shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ /lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnyed nas 'dre bar gnas pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don brtson bsam gtan dang //stobs dang dbang po rnam thar ༅ting 'dzin thob de la/ /'di ni dgon dben spyod pa min ③snyam brnyas ①byed pa/ de ni bdud kyi spyod yul gnas zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /gang zhig grong ngam 'on te dgon par gnas kyang rung / /theg pa gnyis kyi sems bral byang chub mchog nges na/ /'di ni 'gro don zhugs pa rnams kyi dben pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' drod snyam ④de ni bdag nyid nyams / /de lta bas na byang chub dam pa tshol ⑤ba yis/ /bsam pa drag ldan mkhas pas nga rgyal nges bcom ste/ /nad pa'i tshogs kyi ⑥gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar/ /g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes ⑦gnyen bsten par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog zhugs byang chub sems dpa' dag /pha rol phyin dang bcas te dge ba'i bshes su bstenadu/ /de dag rjes su ston byed 'di ni bsgrub pa'i sa/ /rgyu rnam gnyis kyis dhisangs rgyas byang chub myur du rtogs/ /rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcur gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /pha rol phyin 'di byang chub mchog la zhugs rnams kyi/ /gsal dang sgron dang snang dang ston mchog yin zhes bshad/ /ji ltar shes rab pha rol phyin pa mtshan nyid stong / /chos 'di thams cad mtshan nyid de dang 'drar shes shing / /chos rnams stong zhing mtshan ma med par rab shes na/ /de ltar spyod pa bde gshegs shes rab spyod pa yin/ /sems can yongs su rtog pa zas la 'dod byed cing / /'khor bar chags pa'i yid dang 31—425

ldan rnams rtag tu 'khor/ /bdag dang bdag gi chos gnyis yang dag min stong ste/ /byis pa bdag nyid kyis ni mkha' la mdud pa bor/ /dper na dogs pa'i 'du shes kyis ni dug bslang ba/ /dug de khong du song ba med kyang brgyal hu)bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin byis pa bdag dang bdag gir ②khas len pa/ /bdag der 'du shes yang dag mi rtag skye zhing 'chi/ /ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan/ /bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs/ /'di la gang yang nyon mongs rnam dag 'gyur med par/ /byang chub sems dpas shes rab pha rol phyin pa rtogs/ / 'dzam bu'i nigling na sems can ji snyed ma lus pa/ /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /lo stong bye ba mang por sbyin pa byin byas la/ /kun kyang 'gro ba'i don du byang chub rgyur ④bsngo yang / /gang zhig shes rab pha rol phyin mchog mngon brtson pa/ /tha na nyi ma gcig cig rjes su 'thun byed na/ /de la sbyin pa'i phung pos bsod nams char mi phod/ /de phyir g.yel med rtag tu shes rab 'jug par bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med/ /de tshe mkhas pa 'gro ba kun gyi sbyin gnas 'gyur⑤/ /rtag tu yul 'khor bsod snyoms don yod yongs su spyod / /byang chub sems dpa' gang 'dir yun ring yi'abrel ba yi/ /lha mi ngan song gsum gyi sems can dgrol ba'i phyir/ /lam yangs pha rol sems can khams la ston 'dod pas/ /nyin mtshan shes rab pha rol phyin la brtson par bya/ /mi zhig sngon chad ma rnyed pa yi ④rin chen mchog /dus gzhan zhig na rnyed par gyur te dga' ba las/ /rnyed ma thag tu bag med gyur te stor na ni//31—426

stor bas rin chen mngon 'dod rtag tu sdug bsngal lo/ /de ltar byang chub mchog zhugs rin chen lta bu yi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la rnal 'byor dor mi bya//rin chen rnyed nas blangs te rab tu brtson dkris nas/ /myur du 'gro bar byed pa zhi bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /nyi ma sprin dang bral ba'i 'od zer dra ba can/ /mun nag thibs po mun pa thams cad 'joms 'char ba/ /srin bu me khyer srog chags 'byung po thams cad dang / /skar ma'i tshogs dang zla ba'i 'od kun zil gyis gnon/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mchog spyod stong pa dang ni mtshan ma med spyod pa/ /mkhas pas lta ba'i thibs po bcom nas 'gro kun dang / /dgra bcom rang rgyal byang chub sems mang zil gyis gnon/ /dper na rgyal po'i bu zhig nor gtong don 'dod pa/ /kun gyi gtso bor gyur te mngon par 'gro bya 'os/ /'di ni da lta na yang sems can mang dga' byed/ /thabs thob gyur te rgyal srid gnas nas ༅smos ci dgos/ /de ltar shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /bdud rtsi sbyin par byed cing lha dang mi rnams dga'/ /'di ni da lta na yang sems can mang phan brtson / /chos kyi rgyal por gnas par gyur nas ⑤smos ci dgos/ /de yi tshe na bdud ni zug rngu ldan par 'gyur/ /mya ngan nyam ②thag sdug bsngal yid mi bde nyam chung / /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'di yid nur 'gyur zhes/ /'jigs pa bstan phyir phyogs rnams sreg ④cing skar mda' gtong / /gang tshe mkhas pa de dag bsam pa drag ldan zhing / /nyin mtshan shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mchog don lta/ /de tshe lus sems dag ni mkha' 'gro bya ltar rgyu/ /nag po'i rtsa lag rnams kyis glags rnyed ga la 'gyur/ /gang tshe byang chub sems 31—427

dpa' 'thab ①dang rtsod gyur cing / /phan tshun mi 'thun khros pa'i sems dang ldan gyur pa/ /de tshe bdud ni dga' zhing mchog tu nyams bder 'gyur/ /de gnyis rgyal ba'i ye shes las ni ring 'gyur snyam/ /de gnyis ring du 'gyur zhing sha za 'dra bar 'gyur/ / gnyi ga merang gi dam bcas nyams par byed par 'gyur / /sdang zhing bzod dang bral la byang chub ga la yod/ /de tshe bdud rnams phyogs dang bcas te dga' bar 'gyur/ /lung bstan ma thob byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig gis/ /lung bstan thob la sems khros rtsod pa rtsom byed na / /tha ba laskyon ldan sems kyi skad cig ji snyed pa/ /de snyed bskal par gzhi nas go cha bgo bgos ④so/ /sangs rgyas bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pas byang chub reg /sems 'di bzang ba min snyam dran pa skyed byed cing / /so sor 'chags par byed cing phyis kyang sdom byed la/ /dga' bar mi byed de ni sangs rgyas chos 'dir slob/ /gang zhig slob tshe bslab pa gang yang khas mi len/ /slob pa po dang bslab pa'i chos rnams mi dmigs ⑧shing / /bslab ⑥dang bslab pa ma (peyin 'di gnyis mi rtog pa/ /de ltar gang slob de ni sangs rgyas chos 'dir ⑧slob/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de lta'i bslab 'di shes/ /de ni gzhar ⑨yang bslab mnyams tshul khrims 'chal mi 'gyur/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos mnyes bya phyir 'di la slob/ /de ni bslab lhag bslab ⑩la mkhas te dmigs pa med/ /mkhas pa 'od byed rnams kyi shes rab de ltar slob/ /dge ba ma yin sems gcig tsam yang skyed 8mi byed/ /nyi ma mkha' la 'gro ba'i zer gyis zil gnon pa'i/ /mdun gyi bar snang la ni mun pa mi gnas bzhin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la bslab pa byas rnams kyi/ /pha rol phyin pa thams cad 31—428

'dir ni 'dus par 'gyur/ /'jig tshogs lta bar lta ba drug cu gnyis 'dus ltar / /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa 'di dag 'dus par gsungs/ /dper na srog gi dbang po 'gags na dbang po gzhan/ /gang dag ji snyed yod pa thams cad 'gag par 'gyur/ /de ltar shes rab spyod pa mkhas pa mchog rnams kyi/ /pha rol phyin pa thams cad 'dir ni 'dus par gsungs/ /byang chub sems mkhas nyan thos yon tan gang dag dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal yon tan kun la slob byed cing / /de dag de la mi gnas 'dod pa mi bskyed de/ /'di ni bdag gis bslab bya yin snyam de phyir slob/ /mi ldog byang chub mchog la rab tu zhugs pa yispyi/ /sems bskyed tshogepa la bsam pa thag pas yi rang ba/ /stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad gzung rung / /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min/ /dge ba don gnyer phan 'dod sems can ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi bsod nams phung po la yang yi rang 'gyur ri/ /de phyir de dag rgyal ba'i yon tan thob gyur nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'jig rten chos sbyin byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig mi rtog chos rnams kun/ /stong dang mtshan ma med dang spros med yongs shes pa/ /de ni shes rab gnyis kyis byang chub tshol mi byed / /rnal 'byor pa de shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson/ /nam mkha'i khams de dang ni nam mkha' der 'gal ba/ /yod pa ma yin gang gis kyang ni de ma thob/ /de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /nam mkha' lta bu yin te nye bar zhi ba spyod/ /skye bo'i 4dbus na sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di snyam du/ /skye bo 'di mgu bya snyam mi sems de yang byed/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rab tu ston par byed mthong yang / /de la lus med sems med ming yang 31—429

yod ma yin/ /de bzhin shes rab spyod pa nam yang 'di snyam du/ /byang chub rtogs nas 'gro ba yongs su dgrol mi sems/ /skye ba sna tshogs dang ni bya ba mang ldan pa/ /sgyu ma lta bu ston kyang rnam par mi rtog spyod/ /dper na sangs rgyas sprul pa sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed/ /byed pa de la dregs pa cung zad skye mi 'gyur / /de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /sprul pa sgyu ma bzhin du bya ba thams cad ston/ /shing mkhan bzo bo mkhas pas skyes pa bud med dang / /'dra ba'i bzo byas de yang bya ba thams cad byed/ /de bzhin shes rab spyod mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes bya ba thams cad byed/ /de ltar spyod mkhas rnams la lha tshogs mang po dag /thal mo sbyar ba btud nas phyag kyang 'tshal bar byed/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed pa'ang / /yon tan bsngags pa'i phreng ba yongs su brjod par mdzad/ / gang gā'i ⑨klung mnyam zhing na sems can ji snyed pa/ /de kun yongs su brtag pa bzung ste bdud gyur la/ /ba spu ②nyag re las kyang de snyed sprul byas kyang / /de dag kun gyis mkhas la bar chad bya mi nus / /rgyu rnam bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan/ /bdud bzhis thub par dka' zhing bskyod par mi nus te/ /stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi gtong dang / /ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can/ /de bzhin gshegs yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di/ /'chad tshe byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig mos byed cing / /bsam pa thag pas bsgrub ①par mngon par brtson byed na/ /des (pepa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la zhugs rig bya/ /chos dbyings de bzhin nyid la gnas par mi 'gyur zhing / /dper 31—430

na bar snang sprin bzhin gnas pa med par gnas/ /rig sngags 'chang ba gnas med mkha' rgyu gnas 'dod pa/ /sngags mthus dus min me tog ldan shing ①byin gyis rlob/ /de ltar spyod pa byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba/ /rtogs par byed dang sangs rgyas chos rnams dmigs mi 'gyur/ /'chad par byed dang chos 'dod lta bar byed mi dmigs/ /'di ni zhi 'dod yon tan dga' ba'i gnas pa yin/ /dgra bcom rnam thar de bzhin gshegs kyi ma gtogs par/ /gnas pa 'di ni nyan thos rang rgyal bcas pa yi/ /gnas pa zhi ba'i ting 'dzin rab zhi bde ldan pa/ /ji snyed kun gyi mchog dang gong na med pa yin/ /'dab ②chags mkha' la gnas kyang lhung bar 'gyur ma yin/ /nya ni chu la gnas kyang 'tshubs te 'chi ba med/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan stobs dag gis/ /pha rol son pa stong chaganas mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur / /sems can kun gyi yon tan mchog tu 'gro ba dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog tu rmad byung mchog reg dang / /chos kyi sbyin pa rab mchog dam pa sbyin 'dod gang / /phan mdzad rnams kyi gnas mchog 'di la bsten par gyis / /bslab ④pa 'di ni 'dren pas bslab pa yongs brjod na/ /bslab pa ji snyed kun gyi mchog dang gong na med/ /mkhas pa gang zhig bslab kun pha rol 'gro 'dod pas/ /sangs rgyas bslab (5)pa shes rab pha rol phyin 'dir slobs/ /'di ni chos gter mchog dang chos mdzod dam pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rigs yin 'gro ba'i bde dang skyid pa'i mdzod/ /'das dang ma byon phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ /de dag 'di las 'khrungs kyang chos dbyings zad mi shes/ /shing dang 'bras bu me tog nags tshal ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams 31—431

cad sa las yang dag 'byung zhing 'thon/ /'on kyang sa la zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ /yongs su mi nyams rnam par mi rtog skyo ba med/ /sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams ji snyed pa/ /de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung / /shes rab rnams kyang zad pa med cing 'phel ba med/ /sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa/ /de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs / /rkyen rnams tshogs nas sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung / /ma rig 'khrul 'khor de ni zad med 'phel ba med/ /ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung / /rkyen rnams tshogs nas las kyi 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung / /shes rab pha rol phyin la zad med 'phel ba med/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig rten cing 'brel 'byung la/ /skye med zad pa med par shes rab 'di shes te/ /nyi ma sprin med 'od zer 'phro bas mun bsal 1ltar/ /ma rig thibs po bcom nas rang byung thob par 'gyur/ /mthu chen ldan pa bsam gtan bzhis kyang gnas byed la/ /rten /par byed pa ma yin gnas par byed pa med/ /'on kyang bsam gtan yan lag bcas pa bzhi po 'di/ /byang chub dam pa mchog thob pa yi rten du 'gyur / /shes rab mchog thob bsam gtan dag la gnas pa ni/ /gzugs med ting 'dzin dam pa bzhi yang nyams su myong / /bsam gtan 'di dag byang chub dam pa mchog la phan/ /byang chub sems dpa' zag pa zad phyir slob pa min ske/ /'di ni yon tan sogs 4pa'i ngo mtshar rmad 0byung ste/ /bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas mtshan ma med/ /de la gnas rnams gal te 31—432

lus ni zhig gyur na/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'dod pa'i khams su yang skye'o/ /dper na 'dzam gling mi zhig sngon chad lha yul gyi/ / lha yi 1grong khyer mchog tu ma phyin phyis song ste/ /de na yongs su bzung ba'i yul de rnams mthong nas/ /phyir 'dir 'ong bar gyur na chags par mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yon tan mchog 'chang ba/ /rnal 'byor brtson te bsam gtan ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ /phyir yang 'dod pa'i khams su gnas te chags pa med / /chu yi pad ma bzhin du byis pa'i chos mi gnas/ /bdag nyid chen po sems can yongs su smin bya dang / /zhing sbyong pha rol phyin rdzogs don byed kho nar zad/ /byang chub yon tan pha rol phyin nyams 'gyur 'ong zhes/ /gzugs med khams su skye ba don du gnyer mi byed/ /dper na mi zhig rin chen gter rnams rnyed gyur nas/ /de la 'dod pa'i blo ni skyed par ma byas la/ /des kyang dus gzhan zhig na de dag yongs blangs shing / /blangs nas khyim du song ste chags par mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dga' ba dang / /bde sbyin bsam gtan ting 'dzin zhi ba bzhi thob nas/ /bsam gtan bde ldan bsam gtan ting 'dzin thob btang 2ste/ /'gro la snying brtser ldan pa'i phyir yang 'dod khams 'jug /gal te byang chub sems dpa' ting 'dzin bsam gtan gnas/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal theg par 'dod pa'i blo skyed ④na/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rgod cing sems g.yengs gyur pa ste/ /sangs rgyas yon tan yongs nyams mnyan pa gru 5zhig bzhin/ /gzhan yang gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin (6)dri dang ro/ /reg dang 'dod yon lnga la mngon par brtson gyur kyang / /dgra bcom rang rgyal theg bral byang chub sems dga' 31—433

na / /dpa' bo rtag tu mnyam gzhag yin par shes par bya/ /sems can gang zag gzhan phyir sems pa ①rnam dag pa/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin la mngon brtson rnam par spyod/ /dper na bran mo chu chun (snyedabang med rje bo'i dbang / /de bzhin dpa' rnams sems can kun gyi dbang gis 'gro/ /sbyo ba byas sam 'on te rtag tu brdegs (kyekyang rung / /bran mo rje bo la ni zlog tshig mi smra yis4/ /'di yis bdag ni bsad ⑤par 'gyur du 'ong snyam nas/ /shin tu skrag pa'i yid kyis 'jigs bcas zil gyis gnon/ /de bzhin byang chub ched dzinadu byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ /'gro ba kun la bran gyur ⑦bzhin du gnas par bya/ /'di las byang chub thob cing yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur/ /rtswa dang shing las me byung bas ni de nyid sreg /bdag gi bde ba btang nas re ba med sems kyis/ /sems can gzhan gyi dgos la nyin mtshan mngon par brtsonanas / /bu gcig pa la ma ni rim gro byed pa ltar/ /bsam pa thag pas rnam par skyo med gnas par gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig yun ring 'khor 'dod cing / /sems can don dang zhing sbyong stibartson pa'i rnal 'byor pa//skyo ba'i blo ni rdul tsam skye bar mi 'gyur na/ /de ni brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ldan g.yel ba med/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi mkhas bskal pa bye ba bgrang / /gal te ring bar 'du shes sdug bsngal byang chub sgrub/ /yang dag chos sgrub byed tshe yun ring sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /des ⑩ni brtson 'grus pha rol phyin nyams le lo can/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dang po nas bzung ste/ /byang chub bla na med pa thob par 'gyur gyi bar/ /nyin mtshan gcig tsam du ni yid la sems byed 51nyen/ /mkhas pa gsal bas brtson 'grus brtsams par rig par bya/ /31—434

gal te 'ga' zhig 'di skad ri rab ri bshig pa'i/ /rjes la byang chub mchog thob 'gyur zhes smra ba las/ /ci ste skyo ba'i blo bskyed chatshad kyang sems byed na/de tshe byang chub sems dpa' le lor gyur pa yin/ /ji ②ste de ni 'di tsam tshod lta ci dka' ③zhes/ /skad cig tsam la ri rab thal bar rlag ④sems bskyed/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa brtson 'grus brtsams pa ste/ /ring po mi thogs 'dren pa'i byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ /'gro ba yongs su smin par byas nas don bya zhes/ /gal te lus dang ngag dang yid kyis brtson byed na/ /bdag tu 'du shes gnas pas le lor gyur pa ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las ring 'gyur gnam sa bzhin/ /gang tshe lus dang sems dang (snyesems can 'du shes med/ /'du shes rnam par log nas gnyis su med chos spyod/ /'di ni byang chub zhi ba mi nyams mchog 'dod pa'i/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ces phan pa mdzad pas gsungs/ /gal te gzhan las ⑥ngan brjod tshig rtsub thos gyur na/ /bdag bde yin zhes byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dga'/ /su smra sus thos gang gis gang zhig gang gi phyir/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin mchog ldan pa mdzangs ⑦pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig bzod pa'i legs chos ldan/ /gang zhig stong gsum rin chen bkang ste 'jig rten mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang dgra bcom rang rgyal phul byas pa / /sbyin pa'i phung pos de la bsod nams char mi phod/ /bzod la gnas pa'i lus ni yongs su dag gyur 0te/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang mthu stobs pha mtha' yas /sems can rnams la chos rab stong pa sgrogs par byed/ /'di ni bzod ldan de la 'gro ba dga' ⑩'gyur mkhas/ /gal te sems can la las tsan dan phur ma 31—435

blangs / /rab gus byang chub sems dpa' la ni nyug byed la/ /gzhan zhig me mdag mgo la 'thor 1byed gnyi ga nal/ /de yis mnyam zhing snyoms pa'i yid ni bskyed par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pas de ltar bzod byas nas / /sems bskyed de ni byang chub mchog tu yongs bsngos na/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten kun la bzod pas dgra bcom dang / /rang rgyal sems can khams mang ji snyed zil gyis gnon/ /bzod byed 'di snyam du yang sems ni bskyed ②bya ste/ /sems dmyal dud 'gro gshin rje'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal mang / /'dod pa'i yon tan rgyu yis dbang med gnod myong na/ /byang chub ched du ci phyir da 4bzod mi bya snyam/ /lcag dbyig mtshon dang bsad dang bcings dang rdeg 5pa dang / /mgo gcod pa dang rna ba rkang 6kyilag sna gcod dang / /'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed bdag gis bzod snyam pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa'i pha rol phyin la gnas/ /tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par gyur/ /stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med / /sdom pa'i bya ba ji snyed kun gyi rjes su 'jug /sems can kun la phan phyir de yang byang chub bsngo/ /gal te dgra bcom rang rgyal byang chub reg 'dod na/ /tshul khrims 'chal cing 7 mi mkhas de bzhin spyod pa nyams/ /ci ste byang chub zhi ba mchog tu yongs bsngo na/ /'dod yon brtson yang tshul khrims pha rol phyin la gnas/ /chos gang nges pa'i byang chub yon tan 'byung 'gyur ba//'di ni yon tan chos ldan rnams kyi tshul khrims don/ /chos gang phan byed rnams kyi byang chub yongs nyams pa/ /'di ni tshul khrims 'chal ces rnam par 'dren pas gsungs/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang //31wa 436

sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ /sangs rgyas 'grub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na/ /mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya/ /gal te bskal pa bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu/ /spyod kyang dgra bcom rang rgyal nyid la 'dod skyed ①na/ /de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin/ /sems bskyed de ni phas pham pas kyang shin tu rtsi / /tshul khrims srung zhing byang chub mchog tu yongs bsngo la/ /de yis rlom sems med cing bdag stod ②mi byed la/ /nga ①yi 'du shes sems can 'du shes yongs su spangs/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas brjod / /gal te byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i lam spyod pa/ /sems can 'di dag khrims ldan 'di dag khrims 'chal zhes/ /sna tshogs 'du shes zhugs pa shin tu tshul khrims 'chal/ /tshul khrims nyams shing de la yongs dag tshul khrims med/ /gang la bdag gi 'du shes sems can 'du shes med/ /'du shes 'dod chags bral la sdom min ga la yod/ /gang la sdom dang sdom pa ma yin rlom sems med/ /'di ni tshul khrims sdom par rnam par 'dren pas gsungs / /sems can dag pa gang zhig de ltar khrims ldan pa/ /sdug dang mi sdug kun la lta ba med ④pa yin(snye/ /mgo dang rkang lag gtong zhing zhum pa'i sems kyang med/ /bdog pa thams cad gtong ༅zhing rtag tu zhen pa med/ /chos rnams rang bzhin bdag med ya ma brlar gshes nas/ /bdag gi sha yang gtong zhing zhum pa'i sems med na/ /de tshe phyi rol dngos po gtong ba smos ci dgos / /gal te ser sna byed pa de ni gnas med do/ /bdag tu 'du shes dngos la bdag gir 'dzin pas chags/ /blun po rnams la gtong ba'i blo lta ga 31—437

la yod/ /ser sna can ni yi dgas gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /ci ste mir skyes na yang de tshe dbul por 'gyur/ /de tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems can dbul shes nas/ /gtong la mos par 'gyur zhing rtag tu lhag ②par gtong / /gling bzhi legs par brgyan pa mchil ma'i thal ba 'dra/ /byin nas dga' bar 'gyur gyi gling thob de lta min/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa gsal ba srid gsum gyi/ /sems can ji snyed de dag kun la sbyin pa 'di/ /byin par gyur cig snyam du bsams nas sbyin byin la/ /de yang 'gro ba'i don phyir byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /sbyin pa byin nas dngos la gnas par byed pa med/ /de ni nam du'ang rnam par smin la re ba med/ /de ltar gtong la mkhas pa thams cad gtong ②ba ste/ /chung ngu btang la mang po dpag tu med par 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum na sems can ma lus ji snyed pa/ /yongs su brtag par bzung ste de dag thams cad kyis/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dgra bcom rang rgyal la/ /bskal pa mtha' yas sbyin byin nyan thos legs tshol ②na/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa thabs mkhas gang zhig gis/ /de dag bsod nams bya ba'i dngos la yi rang nas/ /sems can don du byang chub mchog rab yongs bsngo na//yongs su bsngos pas 'gro ba thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /nor bu ④mching bu'i phung po chen por gyur pa yang / /rin chen be+e drur+ya dugacig de kun zil gyis gnon/ /de bzhin 'gro kun sbyin pa'i phung po rgya chen kun/ /rjes su yi rang byang chub sems dpas dunazil gyis gnon/ /gal te byang chub sems dpas rdzi 'gro la sbyin byin ⑧nas/ /de la bdag gir mi byed dngos po phangs med na/ /de las dge ba'i rtsa ba mthu chen 'phel 'gyur te/ /sprin med 'od ldan zla dkyil 31—438

yar gyi ngo bzhin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yid btags ①'gro ba gcod / /dbul ba dang ni de bzhin nyon mongs thams cad gcod/ /spyod tshe longs spyod mtha' yas rgyas pa thob par 'gyur/ /sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed/ /khrims kyis dud 'gro'i 'gro ba du ma'i ngo bo dang / /mi khom brgyad spong de yis dal ba rtag tu rnyed/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang dam pa rgya chen thob 'gyur te/ /gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas lta ba'i me'os su 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan 'grib mi 'gyur/ /ye shes mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor/ /rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par sgrub(kye/ /shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ /khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ /mi yi khyu mchog 'khor lo rin chen bskor byas nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston/ /chos 'di yongs rdzogs byas nas byang chub sems dpa' de/ /yongs dag zhing dang sems can dag pa yongs su 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rgyud dang chos kyi rgyud kyang yongs su 'dzin/ /de bzhin dge 'dun rgyud dang chos kun yongs su 'dzin/ /'gro ba'i nad gso mdzad pa sman pa'i mchog gyur pas/ /shes rab bstan pa byang chub lam ldan 'di gsungs te/ /ming ni yon tan rin chen sdud pa byang chub lam/ /lam 'di sems can kun gyis thob par bya phyir bshad / /④zhes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa las/ sdud 2pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u zhes bya ste/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //31—439

gyo)shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa/ bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs nas / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo geng la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshol ②bar 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo des/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu/ da bltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs mi bzad par sgrogs ④pa'i drung ⑧na tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa des yongs su btsal ba de bzhin du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su btsal bar bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su tshol (9)ba na ji ltar yongs su btsal lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu sngon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su tshol (peb na/ lus la ched cher mi 'dzin/ srog la mi lta/rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / tshigs su bcad pa dag la mi gnas par yongs su btsal bas yongs su btsal to/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su tshol nizhing 'brog dgon pa zhig tu phyin pa na/ bar snang la rdo sgra thos par gyur te/ rigs kyi bu shar phyogs su song shig yi dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur gyis/ ji canye7nas lus ngal ba yid la byed pa 31—440

mi skyed hu)pa dang / gnyid dang rmugs pa yid la byed pa mi skyed ②pa dang /bza' ba yid la byed pa mi skyed (0pa dang / btung ba yid la byed pa mi skyed ④pa dang / /mtshan mo yid la byed pa mi skyed (nyepa dang / nyin mo yid la byed pa mi skyed (6dpa dang / grang ba yid la byed pa mi skyed ⑦pa dang / tsha ba yid la byed pa mi skyed 98)pa de ltar song shig(9) /nang dang phyi rol gang la yang sems smon par ma byed cig /rigs kyi bu g.yas g.yon du ma blta 0bar song shig⑩ /nub dang / byang dang / steng dang / 'og dang / phyogs mtshams su yang ma blta hu)bar song shigatuste /rigs kyi bu ci nas 'jig tshogs las kyang ma g.yos pa dang / ci nas gzugs las kyang ma g.yos pa dang / ci nas tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa las kyang ma g.yos pa de ltar song shigatso /gang 'di las g.yos pa de ni rnam par nyams par 'gyur ro/ /ci las nyams par 'gyur zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las nyams par 'gyur ro/ /gang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las nyams par 'gyur ba de ni 'khor ba la spyod do/ /gang 'khor ba la spyod pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rjes su mi 'thob bo/ /de skad ces smras pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus sgra de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /de bzhin du bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag ni sems can thams cad la snang bar 8byed par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad bsgrub par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / sgra des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rtag tu ngu legs so legs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 31—441

chen po rtag tu ngus kyang sgra thos te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu khyod kyis stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i chos dag la mos pa bskyed nyutshol/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su btsal bar bya'o/ /khyod kyis mtshan ma yongs su spang bar bya/ dngos po yongs su spang bar bya/sems can du lta ba yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sdig pa'i grogs po dag spang bar bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang dag stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / ma byung ba dang /ma skyes pa dang / dngos po med pa dang / ma 'gags pa'i chos rnams ston pa dag la bsnyen 5)par bya/ bsten par bya/ bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar bsgrubs na ring po mi thogs par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du chud pa'am/ dge slong chos smra ba'i lus la yod pa thos par 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu gang la (kyelas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos pa de la rigs kyi bu khyod kyis ston par 'du shes bskyed par bya zhing khyod kyis byas pa gzo ba dang / byas pa tshor bar bya ste/ gang las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos pa 'di ni bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de (gi bdag gis thos pas/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la bsnyen par 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de bzhin gshegs pa dang ma bral ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mi khom pa rnams spong bar 'gyur ro/ /dal ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu phan yon 'di rnams khyod kyis 31—442

yongs su rtogs la/ dge slong chos smra ba la ston pa yin par 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'jin rten gyi zang zing dang ldan pa'i sems kyi rgyud kyis/ dge slong chos smra ba'i phyi bzhin 'brang b.re mi bya'i/ khyod ①kyis dge slong chos smra ba las ②chos don du gnyer ba dang / chos la gus par bya bas phyi bzhin 'brang bar bya'o/ /khyod kyis bdud kyi las rnams rtogs par bya ste/ rigs kyi bu bdud sdig can ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg pa dag bsnyen pa dang / bsten pa dang / spyad par bya ba'i phyir nye bar sgrub ③ste/de dag des zil gyis mnan nas thabs la mkhas pas 'grogs shing bsten pa dang / bsnyen par byed pa'ang yod de/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dge slong rjochos smra ba de la ma dad pa bskyed ⑤par mi bya'o/ /gzhan du na sems 'di ltar bskyed par bya ste/ bdag ni thabs mkhas pa de ⑥mi shes kyi/ 'di ni thabs mkhas pa rab tu shes so/ /'di ni sems can gdul ba'i metshul gyis sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su gzung duba'i phyir chos 'di dag la bsten ⑨cing 'grogs te/ bsnyen par byed kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni gang la yang chags pa'am/ sgrib pa med kyis/ skad cig de nyid la rigs kyi bu khyod nyid kyis yang dag pa'i tshul so sor brtag par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i tshul gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin/ rnam par byang ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid kyis hu )stong pa'i phyir te/chos thams cad ni sems can med pa/ srog med pa/ gang zag med pa/31—443

sgyu ma lta bu/ mi lam lta bu/ brag ca lta bu/ mig yor lta bu ste/ rigs kyi bu chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i tshul de ltar rtog cing chos smra ba'i phyir 'brang na ring po mi thogs par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdud kyi las la soms shig /rigs kyi bu gal te chos smra ba dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu la brnyas 1)par byed cing mi sems na/ de la rigs kyi bu khyod kyis phyir dgyed par mi bya ste/ gzhan du na chos don du gnyer ba nyid dang /chos la gus par byed pa nyid dang / yid mi skyo bas dge slong chos smra ba'i phyi bzhin 'brang bar bya'o zhes thos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus sgra de las rjes su bstan pa 'di blangs nas/ shar phyogs ga la ba der song ba dang / ring por ma phyin par de 'di snyam du sems te / bdag gis sgra de la ji srid du 'gro bar (gyibya ba ma dris so snyam nas/ de sa phyogs de nyid na ngu zhing mya ngan byed de smre zhing 'dug go/ /de sa phyogs de na nyin zhag gcig 'das par byed/ nyin zhag gnyis sam/ gsum 'am/bzhi'am / lnga'am/ bdun 'das kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par ma gyur gyi bar du lus ngal ba yid la byed pa ((mi skyed/ba/ rmugs pa dang /gnyid yid la byed pa mi skyed(5na/ bza' (gyerab yid la byed pa mi skyed(3)/ btung ba yid la byed pa mi skyedachos/ mtshan mor yid la byed pa mi skyed7/ nyin mor yid la byed pa mi skyedamu/ grang ba yid la byed pa nyamami skyed3ge/ tsha ba yid la byed pa mi skyed 8do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu la la zhig bu gcig pa 'chi ba'i dus byas na/ sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba chen 31wa 444

po dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de lta bu'i mya ngan gyis bu gcig pu yid la byed pa 'byung ba ma gtogs par yid la byed pa gzhan gang yang mi 'byung ngo / /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu yang de'i tshe/ bdag gis nam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur snyam pa ma gtogs par yid la byed pa gzhan gang yang mi 'byung ngo / /rab 'byor de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de ltar gdung zhing 'dug pa'i mdun du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs shig bzhugs nas/legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu khyod tshig de skad smra ba legs so legs so/ /ji ltar khyod kyis da ltar yongs su btsal ba de bzhin du sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su btsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir khyod kyis brtson 'grus 'di dang / spro ba 'di dang / 'dod ①du gnyer ba 'di dang / 'dod pa 'di lta bus rjes su 'brang zhing / shar phyogs nyid du song shig (kyedang / rigs kyi bu 'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgya na/ spos ldan zhes bya ba'i grong khyer rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i ra ba rim 9babadun gyis bskor ba/ 'obs rim pa bdun dang / shing ta la'i phreng ④rim bdun gyis yongs su bskor ba/ chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis/ zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis yod pa/ 'byor ba rgyas pa/bde ba lo legs pa/ skye bo mang po dang / mis gang ba/ grong bar dang srang mnyam zhing mtshungs pa lnga brgya dag gis ri mor bris pa bzhin du gtams (5)pa/khyogs khri nyam mi nga ba dang / bar bar dag tu zam pa btags pa/ grong 31—445

khyer gyi khor yug tu zhol gyi phyir rin po che sna bdun las legs par byas shing bskor la/ rin po che sna bdun gyi ra ba de dag gi mda' yab rnams ni 'dzam bu'i 1)chu bo'i gser las byas pa/ mtho zhing tshad dang ldan pa/ mda' yab thams cad kyi tshobartse mo las kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi shing skyes te/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing tog gi 'bras bu chags pa/ mda' yab (kyeshing skyes pa thams cad las kyang rin po che'i tha gu byung bas mda' yab cig shos gzhan dang 'brel pa / grong khyer thams cad gser gyi dril bu snyigayer ku'i dra bas khebs te gser gyi dril bu g.yer ka de dag la rlung gis btab na/ sgra 'jam zhing snyan pa yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung ba 'di lta ste/ dper na yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i rol mo 5)tshogs pa/ rol mo mkhan mkhas pas brdungs shing blangs na sgra 'jam zhing snyan la/ yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung ba de bzhin du dril bu g.yer ka de dag la rlung gis btab na/ sgra 'jam zhing snyan pa yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung ste/sgra des sems can de dag rtse dga' zhing dga' mgur spyod do/ /grong khyer de khor yug tu 'obs chu 'bab (6dpas gang zhing chu ha cang yang mi grang / ha cang yang mi dro bas gang ba dag yod do/ /chu de la sngon gyi rnam par smin pas grub pa/rin po che sna bdun gyi rnam par bkra zhing blta na sdug pa'i gagru dag yod de/der sems can de dag zhugs nas rtse dga' zhing rab tu rgyu'o/ /chu de thams cad kyang me tog ut+pa chosal dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dag gis khebs pa/ me tog rigs che zhing bzang la/ dri zhim po'i ngad ldang ba gzhan pa dag gis kyang khebs te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na yod pa'i me tog gi rigs las de na med pa gang yang med do/ /grong khyer 31—446

de'i nang na skyed ①mos tshal lnga brgya yod de/ thams cad kyang rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ rnam par bkra zhing blta ②na sdug pa sha stag ste/ skyed (kyemos tshal de dag re re na yang rdzing bu khor yug tu rgyang grags ④kyi tshad tsam lnga brgya lnga brgya yod de/ rdzing bu de dag gi khor yug thams cad nas rin po che sna bdun gyi me tog ut+pa ⑤la dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po rnam par bkra zhing blta yin sdug pa dag skyes te/ de dag gis chu de khebs shing / me tog ut+pa ⑦la dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po de dag thams cad kyang chu zheng du shing rta'i phang lo tsam ste/ sngon po kha dog sngon po/ sngon po lta bur ston pa/ 'od sngon po 'byung ba/ ser po kha dog ser po/ ser po lta bur ston pa/ 'od ser ④po 'byung ba/ dmar po kha dog dmar po/ dmar po lta bur ston pa/ 'od dmar po 'byung ba/ dkar po kha dog dkar po/〈pedakar po lta bur ston pa/ 'od dkar po 'byung ba dag yod do/ /rdzing bu de dag thams cad na/ ngang ngur dang / khrung khrung dang / bya ka ran da bodang /bzhad sgra 'byin pa dag yod do/ /skyed 7mos tshal de dag thams cad kyang nga yir bya ba 8med cing ris su bcad pa med de/ 'di ltar sems can dag yun ring por shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / yun ring por chos zab mo la mos pa'i sems can de dag gi sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas grub pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu grong khyer de dag gi dbus kyi bzhi hu mdo na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi khang pa rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ khor (/steyug tu dpag hunyetshad kyi tshad tsam yod pa rnam par bkra zhing blta shin sdug pa/ ra ba rim bdun dang / ta la'i phreng rim bdun gyis 31—447

yongs su bskor ba zhig yod de/ khang pa de na khang pa'i longs spyod du rtag tu rab dga' zhes bya ba'i skyed 17mos tshal dang / mya ngan med ces bya ba dang /mya ngan bral zhes bya ba dang / me tog sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i skyed ②mos tshal dang / skyed dmos tshal bzhi yod de/ skyed ri4)mos tshal de dag re re na yang rdzing bu bzang po zhes bya ba dang / bzang mchog ces bya ba dang / dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / dga' mchog ces bya ba dang / bde ba zhes bya ba dang /bde ldan zhes bya ba dang / nges pa zhes bya ba dang / mi 'bab ces bya ba brgyad brgyad yod de/ rdzing bu de dag gi ngos cir/gcig ni gser las byas/ngos gnyis pa ni dngul las byas/ ngos gsum pa ni be+e drur+ya (6)las byas/ngos bzhi pa ni shel las byas/ nang gi sa gzhi ni ke ke ru la/ gser gyi bye ma bdal ba ste/ rdzing bu de dag re re la yang / them skas them pa rin po che sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pas brgyan pa brgyad brgyad yod de/ them skas de dag thams cad kyi bar nas kyang 'dzam bu'i 75chu bo'i gser gyi shing ljon pa dag skyes so / /rdzing bu de dag thams cad kyi chu ni me tog ku mu (8nad dang / ut+pa po)la dang / pad ma dkar po sna tshogs kyis khebs shing / ngang ngur dang / khrung khrung dang / bzhad 7rnams skad 'byin to/ /rdzing bu de dag gi khor 7yug tu me tog gi shing rnam pa sna tshogs skyes te/ shing de dag la rlung gis bskyod pa dang / me tog rnams rdzing bu'i nang du lhung bas/ rdzing bu de thams cad kyi chu yang tsan dan gyi drir phyogs shing kha dog dang ldan/ dri dang ldan no/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'khor dang bcas pa bud med drug khri brgyad stong dang lhan cig tu 'dod pa'i yon tan 8lnga dang ldan 31—448

zhing 'byor te/ rtse ①dga' zhing dga' mgur spyod do/ /grong khyer de (snyen sems can skyes pa dang / bud med gang gzhan dag 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyang skyed ①mos tshal lam④/ rdzing bu dag na rtag tu dga' zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan zhing 'byor te/ rtse dga' zhing dga' mgur spyod do/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de 'khor rnams dang lhan cig tu rtse dga' ste/ dga' mgur spyod cing de na dus gsum du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston to/ /sems can gang dag grong khyer spos ldan na 'khod pa de dag kyang grong khyer gyi dbus kyi bzhi (snyemador byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi khri gser gyi rkang pa dang / dngul gyi rkang pa dang / be+e drur+ya'i ༅rkang pa dang / shel gyi rkang pa btsugs pa/ shing bal bting ba/ stan nang tshangs ④can (debating ba/ steng snying po can du byas pa/ka shi ku'i ras bting ba/ 'phang du rgyang grags phyed yod pa bshams te/steng gi bar snang la ras kyi bla re mu tig gis brgyan pa bres shing / de ltar chos la gus par byed pas sa phyogs de khor 7yug kyang / me tog kha dog sna lnga pa dag mngon par gtor cing sa phyogs de yang spos sna tshogs dang / bdug pa sna tshogs kyis shin tu bdug par byed de/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'dug nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/rigs kyi bu sems can de dag ni de lta bur gus par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyan to/ /de na gang dag nyan pa'i lha dang mi srog chags brgya phrag mang po dang / srog chags stong phrag mang po dang ⑩/ srog chags 'bum phrag mang po 31—449

tshogs pa de dag las/ la la ni klog slob/ la la ni 'dzin/ la la ni 'chang / kha cig ni zlos/0) la la ni lung nod/ la la ni kha ton ②byed/la la ni yi ger 'dri( ra/ la la ni tshul bzhin yid la byed pas rtogs par byed de/sems can de dag thams cad kyang log par mi ltung ba'i chos can debya/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa (nyesha stag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de'i drung du song shig (6skadang / de las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur ro//rigs kyi bu de ni yun ring po nas khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par (7ston pa/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa/ yang dag par gzengs stod ⑧pa/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byed pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ngas 2kyang sngon da ltar khyod ji ltar tshol 1 rib bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su btsal gyis(nye/rigs kyi bu khyod nyin mtshan du yid la byed pa/ rgyun ma gcad par song shig ⑫ dang / ring por mi thogs par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur ro//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus/ de thos nas dga' mgu yid zhugerangs rab tu mgu zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes par gyur pa 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu mde'u dug can zhig gis phog na yid la byed pa gzhan mi bskyed the kyi/ gang bdag sdug bsngal 'di las thar bar byed pa/ zug rngu 'byin pa'i sman pa bdag gis nam rnyed snyam sems pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu yang /gang bdag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de thos par byed cing / chos gang 31—450

thos nas bdag gi dmigs pa yid la byed pa spong bar 'gyur ba'i rigs kyi bu de/bdag gis nam mthong snyam sems pa ma gtogs ①par/ chos gang yang yid la mi byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu sa phyogs de nyid du 'dug ste/ chos thams cad la mi gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas / de ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma mngon du gyur pa 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid la rnam par (shelta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mi shes pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad 'gyur ba med par mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mun pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mi shes pa sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / me tog bkram pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad bdag gi (bdangos po mi sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgyu ma rnam par spangs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / me long gi dkyil 'khor snang ba sgrub ④pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi sgra sgrub ⑤pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad tha dad pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi sgra la mkhas pa'i rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgra dang / tshig dang /'bru sna tshogs sgrub ⑥pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ma khengs pa zhes bya 31—451

ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rang bzhin rnam par bltas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgrib pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa thob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdul dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ming dang nges pa'i sgra dang / tshig dang / 'bru zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gzugs kyi rngul sel ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgyal ba thob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i mig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi dbyings las nges par 'byung ①ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dbugs 'byin pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /seng ge mngon par bsgrags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdul med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / pad ma bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /nem nur gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / snying po thams cad kyi rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mngon par shes pa dang /stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa thob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad las nges par 'bigs 25pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad kyi 'byor pa rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams 31—452

cad bye brag med par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / lta bar gyur pa thibs po ①thams cad rnam par spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /— mun pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mtshan ma dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chags pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / le lo thams cad deng bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos zab mo'i 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ri rab 'dra ba ②zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mi 'phrogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'jig rten gsum la mngon par ma zhen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od zer sgrub ②pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rnams mngon du gyur te/ de ting nge 'dzin de dag la gnas pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa dag /byarnga chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rab tu ston pa dag mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis legs so zhes bya ba byin nas dbugs dbyung ba mdzad de/tshig 'di skad kyang gsung ngo / /rigs kyi bu nged kyis sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bzhin du btsal te/yongs su tshol ④ba na yang ting nge 'dzin 'di dag thob ste/ ting nge 'dzin 'di dag thob nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs par khong du chud par gyur te/phyir mi ldog pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos la gnas par gyur to/ /nged kyis ting nge 31—453

'dzin 'di dag gi ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin la bltas na/ gang mnyam par gzhag par bya ba'am/ ldang bar bya ba'am/ byang chub tu spyad pa'am/ gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i chos de gang yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de yin te/ rigs kyi bu chos gang gis kyang rlom sems sam/ rlom sems med par mi byed pa la gnas nas nged kyis 'di 'dra ba'i lus gser gyi kha dog lta bu thob ste/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / 'od 'dom gang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / sangs rgyas kyi shes rab bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin bla na med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 1)yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rjes su thob ste/ yon tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa dag gis kyang tshad gzung ba'am/mtha' na/bstan par mi nus na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dag gis lta ci smos/ rigs kyi bu de lta bas na khyod kyis chos 'di dag nyid la rab tu don du gnyer ba dang / 'dun pas gus pa mchog tu bskyed par bya ste/rigs kyi bu don du gnyer ba dang / 'dun pa la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnyed par dka' dab ma yin no/ /khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen la shin tu gus pa bskyed par bya'o/ /phangs par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa'i ri cibyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la byang chub 31—454

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang lags de dag gis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod yun ring po nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas shing yongs su bzung ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs mkhas pa la bslabs so/ /rigs kyi bu de ni khyod kyi 0)yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin gyis(ge/ des khyod la ji skad labasgo ba bzhin du zung shig(4) /rigs kyi bu gal te khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa gnyis sam / bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/ de las lhag par yang mgo la thod bzhin du thogs shing / bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis (snyerim gro byas te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg pa ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad phul yang rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de la lan lon pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu de'i mthus khyod kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di lta bu dag rnyed par gyur 96)te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa thos shing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dbugs phyung nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de yang ting nge 'dzin de dag las langs te/ langs nas kyang 'di snyam du sems so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang ma/sa byon/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gang du bzhud 31—455
